description: Four sample and hold circuits gated by a grid of eight preset patterns: a circuit samples only when its cell in the selected row of the selected pattern is lit

params.text: Selects which of the 16 rows of the pattern grid is read, 1 to 16; the seven-segment number above it shows the row after any CV has been added
Scales the row select CV jack beside it, 0 to 1; at 1 a 10V CV shifts the row by the full 16, and at 0 the jack has no effect at all
Selects which of the eight preset patterns is in use, 1 to 8; the seven-segment number above it shows the pattern after any CV has been added
Scales the pattern select CV jack beside it, 0 to 1; at 1 a 10V CV shifts the pattern by the full eight, and at 0 the jack has no effect at all
Scales every voltage leaving the four V.OUT jacks and the POLY V.OUT jack, from 0 at the bottom of its travel to the sampled voltage unchanged at the top; the PULSE outputs are not affected

inputs.text: The voltage this column captures when it samples; it is taken at the instant the trigger arrives
A rising edge through 0.7V makes this column sample its V.IN, and only when the column's cell in the selected row is lit; a cable patched here takes this column out of TRIG ALL's reach
A rising edge through 0.7V samples every column whose cell in the selected row is lit, apart from any column that has its own TRIG IN patched
Added to the ROW SELECT knob after the CV knob beside it scales the voltage, with the total clamped to rows 1 to 16; negative voltages move the selection downwards
Added to the PATTERN SELECT knob after the CV knob beside it scales the voltage, with the total clamped to patterns 1 to 8; negative voltages move the selection downwards

outputs.text: The voltage this column captured at its last sample, scaled by ATTENUATE and held until the next one
A 1ms pulse at 10V each time this column samples, despite the maker's README describing the pulse as a hundredth of a second long
All four columns' held voltages on one cable, as four channels in panel order from left to right, each scaled by ATTENUATE

notes: nothing is sampled until a trigger arrives at a column's TRIG IN or at TRIG ALL, and the V.OUT jacks read 0V until then.
a cable in a CV jack does nothing until the small CV knob next to it is turned up: both attenuator knobs come up at zero, which multiplies the incoming voltage away.
the grid of 64 lamps shows the selected pattern: bright where a cell is lit and in the selected row, dim where it is lit elsewhere, dark where it is not lit. None of them can be clicked.
the ACTIVE lamp above a column is lit while that column's cell in the selected row is lit, which is when a trigger will be let through.
the module is monophonic on every input. Only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read.
with the module bypassed, each V.IN is passed straight through to the V.OUT below it; the trigger inputs, the PULSE outputs and POLY V.OUT are all silent while bypassed.
the maker's hover tooltips name the four columns Block A to Block D, left to right; the panel prints no such letters.
